text:
nina: Heads-up team: CloudVendor + SiliconCo approved for Ottawa-North edge. Need to coordinate marketplace SKUs, quota ask, KMS/HSM attestations, and SI integration tests. Can we split lanes?

rohith: I can take quota + infra numbers. Proposed ask: 40 A100-equivalent GPUs, 300 vCPUs, 2TB scratch. Autoscale policy: min=6 target=20 max=40. Will file ticket today.

mei: For marketplace: we should publish two SKUs (dedicated-standard, dedicated-burst) and attach short usage descriptions. I'll draft listing copy and screenshots. Need pricing input from finance.

partner-bot: Quota ticket created: CV-Q-21234 by rohith  status: open  link: https://partner.cloud/vendor/quotas/CV-Q-21234

rohith: Also requested prefix/KV cache enabled on the model pool. Ops note: set kv_cache=true and warm cache after deploy.

leo: KMS/HSM: SiliconCo requires HSM attestation and a customer-managed key for marketplace images. I've asked for their cert chain and signing nonce vectors (ticket SC-HSM-701). ETA 48h.

legal-bot: Reminder: co-marketing + logo usage needs signed agreement before external PR. Legal contact: katie.

mei: SI integration (ByteWorks) needs temporary API keys for smoke tests and a small sample dataset. Ask: time-limited SA token with inference.invoke and metrics.read scopes. Can infra limit it to ByteWorks CIDR?

rohith: Yes, can provision 72h token and restrict by CIDR. I'll prepare the test harness endpoint and the load profile: 75 concurrent sessions, 1.5k tokens/session, 15m run. Pass if p50 < 180ms, p95 < 800ms, error rate < 1.5%.

nina: Owners: rohith (quotas + infra), mei (marketplace listing + screenshots), leo (KMS/HSM artifacts & attestations), katie (legal + co-marketing). I'll coordinate timeline and lock announcement window.

mei: Draft listing link: https://redwood.internal/drafts/ottawa-north-marketplace. Will add sample screenshots and callouts.

leo: Once SiliconCo posts certs I'll upload to secure bucket and share path in this thread.

rohith: If CV-Q-21234 stays open past 72h I'll escalate to our partner AM and include capacity appendix.

nina: Proposed timeline: internal canary T+2 business days after quota approval, public listing T+6 after HSM attestation and legal signoff. I'll send calendar invite for a checkpoint tomorrow 09:30 PT. :calendar:
